title: ywec.f: node.rs source_matches_sender_iid dead for routable DAO-forward sources (548/610/617/639)
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-ywec. node.rs:748 source_matches_sender_iid(source, sender_iid) = source[8..] == sender_iid. DIO (548) and DIS (639) sources are link-local: valid. DAO-forward path (610, 617) admits is_native_or_global routable sources (615-623), where the check can never match -> gate silently drops or mis-gates forwarded DAOs. Fix routable-source leg to correlate via authenticated sender pubkey AddrForKey, keep link-local IID leg. Sibling defect same_interface (609) for routable prefixes is owned by ax13 - coordinate, do not duplicate. Baseline context: 18 lichen-node tests red on main (see 5217, cpox).
